title: Starbounded SMP Lite
description: A one-click modpack for people who want to play with friends without lag or setup pain.
body:
# Starbounded SMP Lite

Starbounded SMP Lite is a simple Vanilla+ modpack made for playing survival with friends.

I made this pack because a lot of SMP packs are either too heavy, too messy, or full of random mods that nobody actually uses. This one is meant to be easy: install it, make a world or server, invite your friends, and play.

The pack keeps Minecraft feeling like Minecraft, but makes it smoother and more comfortable.

## What’s inside?

- Better performance
- Simple voice chat
- Minimap and waypoints
- Graves, so dying is less painful
- Better exploration
- Useful quality-of-life mods
- Shader support
- Server-friendly settings
- A clean Vanilla+ feel

## Who is this for?

This pack is mostly for small friend groups, private SMPs, and people who want a better survival experience without turning Minecraft into a completely different game.

It should also be good for lower-end PCs compared to huge modpacks.

## The idea

No 400-mod mess.  
No insane setup.  
No random overcomplicated systems.

Just a smoother SMP pack that feels good to play.
